issue.title: Port the small shipping design primitives to native
issue.body:
**Parity unit U7** of the native UI port. The RN app must match the shipping Svelte/Capacitor app.

**What to build:**

| # | Primitive to build in RN | Shipping source | Tokens / specifics to port |
|---|---|---|---|
| P11 | `Disclosure`, `StatusMessage`, `ScrollCue`, `VisuallyHidden`, `ExternalMark` | `design/*.svelte` | `<details>` with a rotating ›; wash banners (success / error / warning); scroll-end fade; hidden live region; "leaves the app" mark. |
| P12 | Confirm card and numbered step | app.css `.confirm-card` / `.confirm-card-content` / `.confirm-card-heading`, `.step-number` | Two-choice card (max 336, padding 24/24/20, lg wash + danger buttons). Paint-blob step badge for Install. |
| P13 | Text input / textarea skin | `AiKeyManager.svelte`, `report/ReportFields.svelte` | Padding 8/12, 1px `--border-warm-strong`, `--radius-sm`, `--surface`. |

**Done when:** the primitive exists in `experiments/native-architecture` with light and dark values drift-guarded against the shipping source (imported or read by a test, never hand-copied). The PR includes a specimen screenshot next to the shipping `/design` styleguide rendering of the same primitive. No visible surface changes yet, except where a caller adopting the primitive is in this unit's scope.

**Order:** after U1, U2.

Shipping is the spec. Read the shipping component first, then match it. The `design` skill names the vocabulary. The parity inventory that produced this issue (2026-10-13) captured screenshot pairs in `/tmp/splotch-parity/` on the build host; regenerate any you need.

Part of #2690.
